The outing

🌳 Hemlock Bluffs Nature Preserve

2616 Kildaire Farm Rd, Cary, NC 27518 · Cary / Apex

Arrive 9 am, leave by 10:45 am · Free · Outdoors

Chilly while you’re there: about 44–48°F. Coats and hats.

Add to calendar

Hemlock Bluffs Nature Preserve

Google CalendarOpens Google Calendar with the event filled in, ready to save. Apple, Outlook or another calendarDownloads a calendar file. Open it on an iPhone, Mac or Outlook and tap Add.

Your 2-year-old can explore the mulched trails and boardwalks, looking for leaves, sticks and little creatures. It is a quiet nature morning that ends well before nap.

  • The boardwalks have stairs, so a carrier can beat a stroller.
  • Pick a short stretch of trail and let your child set the pace.
  • Bring a snack to share on the way back to the car.

What’s at Hemlock Bluffs Nature Preserve, and what else is on there

Crowder County Park

Google CalendarOpens Google Calendar with the event filled in, ready to save. Apple, Outlook or another calendarDownloads a calendar file. Open it on an iPhone, Mac or Outlook and tap Add.

A run around at a playground close by: room to climb, swing and dig, free. It has restrooms, a picnic shelter, a greenway to walk and a garden.

  • Bring water and a snack.
  • Give a five-minute warning before it’s time to go.

Or swap in

  • 📅 Muddy Boots, then Twin Lakes Park

    Twin Lakes-Picnic Shelter · Durham · 8:50 am–10:40 am

    Map · $1.50 for Durham residents, $6.50 for others · Sign-up needed

    Muddy Boots at Twin Lakes starts at 9 am with a nature book and a walk to find nature outside. A family needs to sign up. Afterward your child can play at Twin Lakes Park.

    • Bring a snack for the playground after the walk.

  • 🌷 NC Museum of Art Museum Park, then NCMA to Go Art Kits: Sponge, Stamp, Soar

    Raleigh · 9:30 am–11:15 am

    Map · Museum and park admission is free · Sign-up not listed

    Your child runs on the lawns and spots the big outdoor art at Museum Park. Then the Sponge, Stamp, Soar art kit at 10 am gives hands-on art time.

    • Bring a snack for a break on the lawn.
    • Let your child pick which way to walk on the trails.

  • 🔬 Early Childhood Drop-In

    Hideaway Woods, Museum of Life and Science · Durham · 9:30 am–11:15 am

    Map · Included with museum admission · No sign-up needed

    The Early Childhood Drop-In in Hideaway Woods has sensory play, songs and stories for little ones and their grown-ups. Come and go as your child likes.

    • Stay as long as your child is happy and leave when interest fades.
    • Bring a snack for a break between activities.

  • 🌷 JC Raulston Arboretum

    Raleigh · 2:30 pm–4:15 pm

    Map · Free

    After nap, your child can wander the garden paths and look at leaves, seed pods and plants. It is a calm way to spend the afternoon.

    • Bring a snack and water for a bench break.
    • Let your child choose which path to take next.

Nothing else fits that today.

Or swap in

  • 🌳 Hemlock Bluffs Nature Preserve

    Cary / Apex · 9 am–10:45 am

    Map · Free

    Your 2-year-old can explore the mulched trails and boardwalks, looking for leaves, sticks and little creatures. It is a quiet nature morning that ends well before nap.

    • The boardwalks have stairs, so a carrier can beat a stroller.
    • Pick a short stretch of trail and let your child set the pace.
    • Bring a snack to share on the way back to the car.

  • 📅 Muddy Boots, then Twin Lakes Park

    Twin Lakes-Picnic Shelter · Durham · 8:50 am–10:40 am

    Map · $1.50 for Durham residents, $6.50 for others · Sign-up needed

    Muddy Boots at Twin Lakes starts at 9 am with a nature book and a walk to find nature outside. A family needs to sign up. Afterward your child can play at Twin Lakes Park.

    • Bring a snack for the playground after the walk.

  • 🔬 Early Childhood Drop-In

    Hideaway Woods, Museum of Life and Science · Durham · 9:30 am–11:15 am

    Map · Included with museum admission · No sign-up needed

    The Early Childhood Drop-In in Hideaway Woods has sensory play, songs and stories for little ones and their grown-ups. Come and go as your child likes.

    • Stay as long as your child is happy and leave when interest fades.
    • Bring a snack for a break between activities.

  • 🌷 JC Raulston Arboretum

    Raleigh · 2:30 pm–4:15 pm

    Map · Free

    After nap, your child can wander the garden paths and look at leaves, seed pods and plants. It is a calm way to spend the afternoon.

    • Bring a snack and water for a bench break.
    • Let your child choose which path to take next.

Forest Hills Park

  • 📅 Muddy Boots, then Twin Lakes Park

    Twin Lakes-Picnic Shelter · Durham · 8:50 am–10:40 am

    Map · $1.50 for Durham residents, $6.50 for others · Sign-up needed

    Muddy Boots at Twin Lakes starts at 9 am with a nature book and a walk to find nature outside. A family needs to sign up. Afterward your child can play at Twin Lakes Park.

    • Bring a snack for the playground after the walk.

  • 🔬 Early Childhood Drop-In

    Hideaway Woods, Museum of Life and Science · Durham · 9:30 am–11:15 am

    Map · Included with museum admission · No sign-up needed

    The Early Childhood Drop-In in Hideaway Woods has sensory play, songs and stories for little ones and their grown-ups. Come and go as your child likes.

    • Stay as long as your child is happy and leave when interest fades.
    • Bring a snack for a break between activities.

  • 🌷 NC Museum of Art Museum Park, then NCMA to Go Art Kits: Sponge, Stamp, Soar

    Raleigh · 9:30 am–11:30 am

    Map · Museum and park admission is free · Sign-up not listed

    Your child runs on the lawns and spots the big outdoor art at Museum Park. Then the Sponge, Stamp, Soar art kit at 10 am gives hands-on art time.

    • Bring a snack for a break on the lawn.
    • Give a heads-up before heading in for the art kit.

  • 🌳 Hemlock Bluffs Nature Preserve

    Cary / Apex · 9 am–10:45 am

    Map · Free

    Your child can explore the mulched trails and boardwalks, looking for leaves and little creatures.

    • The boardwalks have stairs, so a carrier can beat a stroller.
    • Bring a snack to share before the drive home.

  • 📖 Family Storytime, then Knightdale Station Park

    East Regional Library · East Wake · 10:05 am–11:25 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Family Storytime at East Regional Library at 10:15 am has books, music, rhymes and movement. Then your child can play at Knightdale Station Park.

    • Sing along so the park feels like a reward.
    • Bring a snack for the picnic shelter.

  • 🌳 Gipson Play Plaza at Dix Park

    Raleigh · 3 pm–4:15 pm

    Map · Free

    After nap, your 2-year-old has a big playground at Dix Park for climbing and sliding.

    • Bring a snack and water for a break halfway through.
    • Name one last slide so leaving is not a surprise.

  • 📖 Family Storytime, then Seagroves Farm Park

    Eva Perry Regional Library · Cary / Apex · 10:20 am–11:40 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Family Storytime at Eva Perry Regional Library at 10:30 am has books, rhymes, music and movement. Then your child can run at Seagroves Farm Park.

    • Pick up a ticket at the Youth Services desk when you arrive.
    • Bring a snack for the park.
